decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This development shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Condition : 2 - The window in the second floor southern flank elevation shall be glazed with obscured glass in the future, unless approved otherwise by the local planning authority in writing.
To control overlooking, and safeguard the privacy of neighbours in accordance with Council policy DMS1(c)
Condition : 3 - The external materials to be used in the approved development shall match those of the existing building.
In the interest of the appearance of the development, in accordance with Council policy DMS1
Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, or any future enactment of that Order, no windows, doors or glazed areas (other than such as may be shown on the approved plans) shall be formed in the southern flank wall of the extension without the prior written consent of the local planning authority.
To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking, in accordance with Council policy DMS1
Condition : 5 - The roof of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden, sitting out area or for any purpose of a similar nature without the prior written consent of the local planning authority.
To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking, in accordance with Council policy DMS1
Condition : 6 - REASON FOR GRANTING PLANNING PERMISSION
The Council has had regard to local development plan policies, to any representations received and to other material planning considerations. 
The following policies were considered relevant to the grant of planning permission: DMS1, DMH5 of the Development Management Policies Document.
The proposal has been granted planning permission for the following reasons:
The development is considered to not be detrimental to the visual appearance of the property, nor is it considered to have a significant impact on the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and the development is substantially in accordance with policies DMS1 and DMH5 of the Development Management Policies Document. 
Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE: Recent legal changes under The Water Industry (Scheme for the Adoption of private sewers) Regulations 2011 mean that the sections of pipes you share with your neighbours, or are situated outside of your property boundary which connect to a public sewer are likely to have transferred to Thames Water's ownership. Should your proposed building
work fall within 3 metres of these pipes we recommend you contact Thames Water to discuss their status in more detail and to determine if a building over / near to agreement is required. You can contact Thames Water on 0845 850 2777 or for more information please visit our website at www.thameswater.co.uk
description: Construction of an additional storey above the rear addition; a dormer rear roof extension; and a single storey side/rear extension.
